lessons_used: Evidence is still thin across all kinds of change, as only one test has been completed so far.

candidates.title: Split Layout Pet Selection Showcase
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout showcasing live animated pet previews alongside choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long decision time. A side-by-side visual showcase helps users evaluate companions faster.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection layout is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the lowest-converting step (60.9%), but full redesign requires significant screen effort.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet adoption choices so users choose their pet before creating or logging into an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently happens before pet choice causing 27.1% drop-off; deferred authentication lets users experience core value first.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Preview Stage
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated pet preview screen after pet selection showing pet animations and audio samples before final adoption.
candidates.why: Support logs show 3 complaints about custom pets failing or looking wrong. A verification preview step builds confidence in pet appearance.

new_pet_preview.headline: Meet Your Future Companion
new_pet_preview.body: Here is how your pet will look and react on your desktop.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Placement Sandbox Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive placement testing zone on the final home intro screen so users test desktop pet placement prior to launch.
candidates.why: Support received multiple issues where pets did not show on the desktop or users felt lost controlling desktop pet behavior.

home_intro.headline: Position Your Pet On Desktop
home_intro.body: Drag your companion around the preview screen to choose their favorite desktop spot.

guard.reason: Adding desktop placement sandbox components to home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by emails and similar to tested finish flow (+6.3%), but high effort to build interactive sandbox.

candidates.title: Two-Column Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Change the choose_path screen layout to two-column format comparing ready-made adoptable pets directly with custom pet generation.
candidates.why: Path selection has a high mean duration of 514s; presenting both paths side-by-side reduces evaluation time and cognitive friction.

guard.reason: Changing choose_path to a two-column layout preserves its function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high decision time on path selection via side-by-side layout layout change.

candidates.title: Path Selection Value Proposition Copy
candidates.change: Reframe the choose_path headline and body to highlight quick pet adoption versus personalized pet creation.
candidates.why: 76.2% conversion with long mean time indicates users are uncertain about what each onboarding branch offers.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Meet Your Companion?
choose_path.body: Pick an instant companion ready to play, or upload photos to build a unique custom desktop pet.

guard.reason: Copy update clearly presents both adopt and custom creation options.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change to resolve path decision uncertainty.

candidates.title: Cloud Sync & Pet Recovery Account Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in saves pet memories and prevents desktop pet resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or resetting after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in binds your pet's personality and progress to your account so you never lose your friend.

guard.reason: Informational cloud sync hint on sign-in is allowed and fair.

candidates.score_note: Strongest evidence (top support issue with 8 emails) and low cost hint addition.

candidates.title: Pet Incubation Progress & Tip Banner
candidates.change: Enable time estimates, progress bars, and desktop interaction tips on the waiting screen during pet asset generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s (mean 2336s); active status feedback prevents users from assuming the app stalled.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to hide or open chat controls.

guard.reason: Adding time estimates and tips to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targeting extreme wait times on home step with incubation progress cues.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Guidance Banner
candidates.change: Add photo quality instructions and automatic notification badges on the photo upload screen during custom pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly due to poor input images.

upload_photos.hint: Use bright, clear front-facing photos for the best 3D pet generation results.

guard.reason: Photo quality guidance and notification toggles on upload_photos are permitted.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 3 support tickets addressing photo upload failures on adoption step.

candidates.title: Starter Accessory Unlock Badge
candidates.change: Display an exclusive onboarding completion reward badge on home_intro unlocking a free starting pet accessory.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 21.2%; offering an instant reward right at the end boosts motivation to complete setup.

home_intro.headline: Onboarding Complete! Your Starter Toy Unlocked

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions unlocked gifts/free extras, violating Rule 3.

held_by_harm_budget: Cloud Sync & Pet Recovery Account Hint
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin across all kinds of change, as only one test has been completed for each category so far.
